_comment: Expert registry. Three categories: 'super' agents are jobs (Consultant, Lawyer, Engineer…) — their `label` IS the role, designed for productivity gains on existing tasks. 'genius' agents are historical figures unlocking creative or service outputs the user couldn't produce alone (DaVinci builds visual universes, Wolfgang composes music, Alfred runs your Mac as your majordome, Socrates interviews you to draft new experts) — their `label` is the genius's name. 'coach' agents help you grow in a life domain (diet, learning, sport, cooking) — their `label` is 'X Coach'. Sub-fields: `role` (optional subtitle for tooltips), `kind` (informational taxonomy), `category` (drives roster UX), `skills` (mounted SKILLs — a name not yet vendored under skills/<name>/SKILL.md is silently skipped), `status` ('active' by default; 'next' = visible in the Cabinet's deferred section but hidden from the active picker/composer surfaces, used when the persona needs a piece we haven't shipped yet — Sales/PM need the Cartographer's machine-context mapping to be worth using). The slug (key) is the stable identifier used in personas/skills and never changes. User-created custom experts live in <VAR_DIR>/experts/<slug>.{md,json}. The `memory` skill (the vault doctrine — $SPLIT_VAULT) is auto-mounted globally on every expert; it is not listed per-expert.
